cohort: 155 Caucasian pregnant women classified as either term (>=38 0/7 weeks, n = 107) or preterm (<=36 6/7 weeks, n = 48) deliveries.
finding: Women who experienced preterm delivery had a higher microbial richness and diversity in their vaginal microbiome, with decreased Lactobacilli spp. and increased abundance of genera associated with bacterial vaginosis and aerobic vaginitis.
